can_do.en: Say who you are and why you have come; correct a misunderstanding.
can_do.de: Sagen, wer du bist und warum du gekommen bist; ein Missverständnis richtigstellen.
can_do.fr: Dire qui on est et pourquoi on est venu ; corriger un malentendu.

movements.visual: Night rain on the quai de Valmy. The red neon MISTRAL on the corner. Toi from behind, with a suitcase and an envelope held under the coat against the rain. Through the café's window, Gus stands on the booth's bench mid-anecdote, and Marin and Lila look up at him. Far background, rue de Lancry: a third-floor window, an old man at an easel, tiny, never lit brighter than the street.

say.a2: Paris. Le 11 novembre. Il pleut. Tu as une valise, une lettre et une clé.
say.b1: Paris, un 11 novembre sous la pluie. Une valise, une lettre du notaire, et une clé qui n'est pas encore à toi.

native.en: Paris. 11 November. It's raining. You have a suitcase, a letter and a key.
native.de: Paris. Der 11. November. Es regnet. Du hast einen Koffer, einen Brief und einen Schlüssel.

movements.note: Far background, rue de Lancry: «L.» at his easel. Never mentioned.

movements.visual: Inside Le Mistral. The door's bell. Heads turn. Gus is still standing on the bench, one hand raised, and freezes mid-story. Marin holds a spoon of soup halfway to his mouth. Lila, chin on her fist, is already interested.

say.a2: …Et le duc me dit : "Augustin, vous êtes trop élégant pour ce siècle."
say.b1: …Et là, le duc se tourne vers moi : "Augustin, vous êtes bien trop élégant pour ce siècle."

native.en: …And the duke says to me: "Augustin, you are too elegant for this century."
native.de: …Und der Herzog sagt zu mir: "Augustin, Sie sind zu elegant für dieses Jahrhundert."

movements.visual: The zinc, close. Toi's hand sets down the envelope, and on top of it the key ring: an old key and a small enamel cicada, green and gold. Margaux's hand, drying a glass, stops. We see only her hand and the cicada.
Gus steps down from the bench and crosses the room with a bow that is too deep. The group watches behind him.

say.a2: Ah ! Vous voilà. La personne de M. Marchand, je suppose ? On vous attend.
say.b1: Ah ! La personne de chez Marchand, je présume ? On vous attendait… avec impatience, évidemment.

native.en: Ah! There you are. M. Marchand's person, I suppose? We've been waiting for you.
native.de: Ah! Da sind Sie ja. Die Person von Herrn Marchand, nehme ich an? Wir warten auf Sie.

movements.visual: Marin stands and politely pulls out a chair for Toi, then cannot help himself. Behind him, Lila looks down at Toi's feet.

say.a2: Vous allez vraiment vendre l'appartement d'Odile ? À Solvel ?
say.b1: …Vous allez vraiment vendre l'appartement d'Odile ? À ces gens-là ?

native.en: Are you really going to sell Odile's flat? To Solvel?
native.de: Wollen Sie wirklich Odiles Wohnung verkaufen? An Solvel?

say.a2: Regarde ses chaussures, Marin. Ce n'est pas Solvel, ça.
say.b1: Regarde ses chaussures. Personne chez Solvel ne porte ça.

native.en: Look at the shoes, Marin. That's not Solvel.
native.de: Schau dir die Schuhe an, Marin. Das ist nicht Solvel.

movements.note: Lila's first line in the season is a deduction, and it is right. She is the only one who looks at the evidence.

panel.visual: Gus leans on the zinc beside Toi in his three-piece suit, all charm and no warmth. Toi's balloon, empty, is drawn from behind Toi's shoulder.

task.en: Say who you are and why you are here, to a room that has already decided.
task.de: Sag, wer du bist und warum du hier bist – vor einem Raum, der sich schon ein Urteil gebildet hat.
task.fr: Dis qui tu es et pourquoi tu es là, devant une salle qui a déjà décidé.

movements.listens_for: Identity (the learner is Odile's family) and purpose (the flat, selling, a week). A learner who has just started can do this in four words.

replies.label: Identity first
replies.means: The learner says they are Odile's family (grandchild), before or without the purpose.

beats.visual: The room, silent. Margaux puts a cup in front of Toi: a café crème nobody ordered.

replies.label: Honest purpose
replies.means: The learner says they came to sell, or that the flat is theirs now, without first saying they are family.
examples: Je viens pour vendre. L'appartement est à moi, maintenant.

beats.visual: Gus's triumph deflates. The room looks from him to Toi.
beats.note: They were wrong about who, not about what. Nobody punishes the learner for honesty. Margaux, who recognised the cicada, corrects the room.

replies.label: Clumsy but sincere
replies.means: A halting reply that still gets across 'not Marchand's person; Odile is my grandmother; the key was hers', or any sincere attempt at who the learner is.
examples: Moi… pas Marchand. Odile… grand-mère. La clé, c'est à elle.

beats.visual: Toi holds up the key ring; the cicada catches the light. Lila jumps up from the booth.

say.a2: Sa petite… son petit… Bref ! C'est la famille d'Odile !
say.b1: Sa petite… son petit… Enfin, bref ! C'est la famille d'Odile, bande d'idiots !

native.en: Her grand… her grand… Anyway! It's Odile's family!
native.de: Ihre Enke… ihr Enke… Egal! Das ist Odiles Familie!

beats.visual: Margaux puts a cup in front of Toi: a café crème nobody ordered.

beats.note: Lila stumbles over the gendered word because she does not know it yet, and the joke is hers. From here on she calls you «l'héritage».

replies.label: Counter-attack
replies.means: The learner turns the question back on Gus: and who are you?

say.a2: Augustin de Roncourt. Et vous me plaisez.
say.b1: Augustin de Roncourt, pour vous servir. Et vous me plaisez déjà.

native.en: Augustin de Roncourt. And I like you.
native.de: Augustin de Roncourt. Und Sie gefallen mir.

say.a2: C'est la famille d'Odile, Gus. Assieds-toi.

native.en: It's Odile's family, Gus. Sit down.
native.de: Das ist Odiles Familie, Gus. Setz dich.

panel.visual: Margaux picks up the key ring and turns the cicada in her fingers. Marin and Lila lean in from the booth. Gus pretends not to.

say.a2: Elle ne donnait jamais cette clé.
say.b1: Elle ne prêtait jamais cette clé. À personne.

native.en: She never gave that key to anyone.
native.de: Diesen Schlüssel hat sie nie hergegeben.

panel.note: Margaux uses tu with you at once, as she did with Odile. Nobody comments on it.

task.en: Say whether you will go up tonight, and what you plan to do.
task.de: Sag, ob du heute Abend hochgehst und was du vorhast.
task.fr: Dis si tu montes ce soir, et ce que tu comptes faire.

movements.listens_for: Whether the learner will go up to the flat tonight, and what they plan (to sell and leave, to wait, not to know).

replies.label: Yes, tonight
replies.means: The learner wants to go up tonight.

beats.visual: Margaux gives the key ring back across the zinc.

replies.label: I don't know
replies.means: The learner does not know yet, or hesitates.

native.de: Das ist gut. Warte ein bisschen.

replies.label: Sell and leave
replies.means: The learner says they will sell and leave, in a week.
examples: Je vends et je pars. Une semaine.

beats.visual: Gus throws up his hands; Marin leans in to explain; Lila shushes him.

say.a2: Une semaine ! Personne ne reste une semaine à Paris. Moi, je suis venu pour un café.

native.en: A week! Nobody stays a week in Paris. I came for one coffee.
native.de: Eine Woche! Niemand bleibt eine Woche in Paris. Ich bin wegen eines Kaffees gekommen.

replies.label: Clumsy but sincere
replies.means: A halting reply: going up tomorrow, a little afraid.
examples: Monter… demain ? J'ai peur un peu.

panel.visual: The bell again. In the doorway stands a figure in a rain-soaked bike helmet, holding up a key: Camille, seen from the side, not yet in close-up. On the zinc in the foreground lies Toi's key with its cicada. Two keys in one frame. Gus looks from one to the other.

say.a2: Bonsoir. Camille Marchand. Je viens pour le premier étage. J'ai la clé.

native.en: Good evening. Camille Marchand. I'm here about the first floor. I have the key.
native.de: Guten Abend. Camille Marchand. Ich komme wegen des ersten Stocks. Ich habe den Schlüssel.

say.a2: Deux clés pour la même porte. À suivre…
say.b1: Deux clés, une seule porte. À suivre…

native.en: Two keys for the same door. To be continued…
native.de: Zwei Schlüssel für dieselbe Tür. Fortsetzung folgt…
